page.overview:
Who is Gyokko?

Before becoming a demon, he was a human by the name of |Managi}}.

Gyokko had a bizarre and grotesque physiology, taking on the form of a pale white, abstracted humanoid figure with an armless, muscular upper torso. His figure resembled a djinn surfacing from a white porcelain vase, which was decorated with branches of green leaves along with red, yellow and purple flowers. His midsection was a red-violet color while his lower-half was black. He had multiple underdeveloped and infant-like hands with red fingernails; four on his head that replaced his ears, and several on his body and tail, which he could retract at will. He also possessed thin fins on the top and back of his head in place of his hair; these were of a blended hue of purple and blue-violet, as well as shaped in the style of cornrows and a ponytail.

Gyokko’s face had a deeply distorted appearance alongside his sharp nose. His large, green-lipped mouths were located where one’s eye sockets normally would be, displaying his hyper-realistic teeth and occasionally his tongues. The twin green mouths were usually expressionless and only moved when he spoke or ate. His actual eyes were located vertically from one another on his face. One of them was the constantly opened bottom mouth, which was usually contorted when Gyokko displayed emotions and featured a golden-yellow iris, a honey-brown center and visible veins. Similar in appearance, the other one was seated at the center of his forehead. Three brown dots were on top of the latter eye. The kanji for |Jōgen}} was engraved on his forehead's eye, and the daiji for |Go}} was engraved on his mouth's.

When in battle, Gyokko was shown to molt and transform into his true form, which bore heavy resemblance to a merman. In this state, Gyokko retained his facial features and muscular physique, but now possessed a more humanoid body. His two large arms replaced his various small ones, alongside webbed hands with turquoise scales and sharpened fingers. Although he didn't have legs, Gyokko instead acquired a long, teal, serpent-like tail. He also grew much larger, became covered in transparent scales, and attained dark markings on various places around his body. While he still kept his cornrow-styled "hair", Gyokko obtained several more blue-violet fins across his body: he had a long mane comprised of them, which lined up the top-half of his tail. Additionally, the mouth which displayed his lower eye had four stitches - two on each side, giving it a ragdoll-like appearance.
